description: Roll sealed dice freight through nonperiodic moving apertures while maintaining its labelled 3D orientation.
name: Blind Dice Courier V2 · Difficulty 4 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Deliver the labelled die through every sliding face gate to the green dock. One press rolls it one square in 0.9 seconds. Match each gate’s top face (and east face when marked) on arrival, and keep the whole tipping die inside every moving opening until it clears. Scanners reveal sealed faces. The sweep rails show current and upcoming turns. A shutter contact, wrong face, or incomplete submission ends this episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload, navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to or interact with pre-existing, unrelated, blank, or browser-settings tabs. Tabs opened by visible task controls are allowed only if they are part of this task, using their visible controls only.
